comment:
* Provides lightweight S2 cell ID utilities without traditional geometry dependencies. * *

See the S2 Geometry Library website for more details.

variables.name: MAX_LEVEL
variables.comment: The level of all leaf S2 cells.

variables.name: I_SHIFT
variables.comment: Used to encode (i, j, o) coordinates into primitive longs.

methods.name: public static long fromLatLngDegrees(double latDegrees, double lngDegrees)
methods.comment:
* Returns the leaf S2 cell ID for the specified latitude and longitude, both measured in
     * degrees.

methods.name: public static long fromFij(int face, int i, int j)
methods.comment: Returns the leaf S2 cell ID of the specified (face, i, j) coordinate.

methods.name: public static int getFace(long s2CellId)
methods.comment:
* Returns the face of the specified S2 cell. The returned face is in [0, 5] for valid S2 cell
     * IDs. Behavior is undefined for invalid S2 cell IDs.

methods.name: public static long getParent(long s2CellId, int level)
methods.comment:
* Returns the ID of the parent of the specified S2 cell at the specified parent level.
     * Behavior is undefined for invalid S2 cell IDs or parent levels not in
     * [0, {@code getLevel(s2CellId)}[.

methods.name: public static void getEdgeNeighbors(long s2CellId, @NonNull long[] neighbors)
methods.comment:
* Inserts into {@code neighbors} the four S2 cell IDs corresponding to the neighboring * cells adjacent across the specified cell's four edges. This array must be of minimum * length four, and elements at the tail end of the array not corresponding to a neighbor * are set to zero. A reference to this array is returned. * *

Inserts in the order of down, right, up, and left directions, in that order. All * neighbors are guaranteed to be distinct.

methods.name: public static int getI(long s2CellId)
methods.comment: Returns the "i" coordinate for the specified S2 cell.

methods.name: public static int getJ(long s2CellId)
methods.comment: Returns the "j" coordinate for the specified S2 cell.

methods.name: private static long fromLatLngRadians(double latRadians, double lngRadians)
methods.comment:
* Returns the leaf S2 cell ID for the specified latitude and longitude, both measured in
     * radians.

methods.name: static int getLevel(long s2CellId)
methods.comment:
* Returns the level of the specified S2 cell. The returned level is in [0, 30] for valid
     * S2 cell IDs. Behavior is undefined for invalid S2 cell IDs.

methods.name: static long getLowestOnBit(long s2CellId)
methods.comment: Returns the lowest-numbered bit that is on for the specified S2 cell.

methods.name: static long getLowestOnBitForLevel(int level)
methods.comment: Returns the lowest-numbered bit that is on for any S2 cell on the specified level.

methods.name: static long getTraversalStart(long s2CellId, int level)
methods.comment:
* Returns the ID of the first S2 cell in a traversal of the children S2 cells at the specified
     * level, in Hilbert curve order.

methods.name: static long getTraversalNext(long s2CellId)
methods.comment: Returns the ID of the next S2 cell at the same level along the Hilbert curve.

methods.name: static String getToken(long s2CellId)
methods.comment:
* Encodes the S2 cell id to compact text strings suitable for display or indexing. Cells at
     * lower levels (i.e., larger cells) are encoded into fewer characters.

methods.name: private static long fromXyz(double x, double y, double z)
methods.comment: Returns the leaf S2 cell ID of the specified (x, y, z) coordinate.

methods.name: private static long fromFuv(int face, double u, double v)
methods.comment: Returns the leaf S2 cell ID of the specified (face, u, v) coordinate.

methods.name: private static long fromFijWrap(int face, int i, int j)
private static long fromFijSame(int face, int i, int j, boolean isSameFace)
private static int xyzToFace(double x, double y, double z)
methods.comment:
* Returns the face associated with the specified (x, y, z) coordinate. For a coordinate
     * on a face boundary, the returned face is arbitrary but repeatable.

methods.name: private static int lookupBits(int i, int j, int k, int bits)
private static long updateBits(long sb, int k, int bits)
private static void initLookupCell(int level, int i, int j, int origOrientation, int pos, int orientation)
